title: How can I maintain balance?
subtitle: Evidence-based answer to the common question: how can I maintain balance?
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the role of multisensory inputs and balance exercises in improving postural control and reducing fall risk. Nutrition and hydration are emerging factors with moderate evidence. Limitations include individual variability and need for professional evaluation in some cases.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
